entities.summary: District Stadium, Chittagong, officially known as MA Aziz Stadium and formerly known as Niaz Stadium, is a multi-purpose stadium in Chittagong, Bangladesh. The stadium currently operated by the Bangladesh Football Federation, predominantly hosts football matches and has previously been used by the Bangladesh national football team. Its total capacity is 40,000.
